rag.text:
Test: TC-6217 — Box Module - Reports - Tabs - Creating new tabs
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-104 Box Module - Reports
Labels: teamsmile

Steps:
1. Navigate to Reports module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-6217 Box Module - Reports - Tabs - Creating new tabs
   Expected: Reports module is loaded correctly.

Default tab is selected.

There is one report added: Task report
2. Change mode to Edit
   Expected: Mode is changed.

Next to Default tab there is + button visible.
3. Click on + button next to Default tab
   Expected: Create new dashboard dropdown menu is displaying.

There are two options:

* Empty
* From existing template
4. Click on Empty option
   Expected: New dashboard tab is added.

There is no reports in newly created tab.

Splash screen: No reports to display is visible.
5. Change name of newly created tab to tabName and click outside a field
   Data: * tabName: TC-6217 Tab
   Expected: Tab name is changed to tabName

Tab is selected.
6. Click on + button next to tabName tab and hover over From existing template option
   Data: * tabName: TC-6217 Tab
* template: TC-6217 Template
   Expected: template is displaying on a list of templates
7. Click on template
   Data: * template: TC-6217 Template
   Expected: New dashboard tab with name: template is added.

There are three reports visible:

* Status per Assignee
* Assignee per Status
* Issue Type per Status
8. Click on tabName to change dashboard
   Data: * tabName: TC-6217 Tab
   Expected: Dashboard is changed.

There is no reports added in tabName.

Splash screen: No reports to display is visible.
